intent.proves: At least one live favorites paragraph (Swift-V2_Favorites, Swift-v2_ProductAddToFavorites) exists.
intent.scope: all non-deleted paragraphs on the solution

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph WHERE ParagraphItemType IN ('Swift-V2_Favorites', 'Swift-v2_ProductAddToFavorites') AND ParagraphDeleted = 0
